title: Agent Permission Denied Details
description: Recommended details shape for `PERMISSION_DENIED` errors when the gate that fired is a non-status per-agent gate (`scope: "agent"` plus a registered `reason`): a provisioning constraint the seller applies to the agent, such as `sandbox_only`, or an authority outcome about the brand's published grants, such as `grant_absent`. Distinct from generic credential-shaped permission failures (no `scope`), from per-account/per-task authorization failures (`SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT`, `READ_ONLY_SCOPE`, `FIELD_NOT_PERMITTED`), and from per-agent commercial-status rejections (`AGENT_SUSPENDED` / `AGENT_BLOCKED`, which are their own discriminator codes and do NOT carry an explicit `scope` field). The shape carries a registered `reason` value identifying the gate; `additionalProperties: false` clamps it so adopters cannot invent ad-hoc per-agent state keys (rate cards, payment terms, credit limit, billing entity, custom reason strings) — full disclosure of the agent's commercial state in a single probe is a per-agent oracle the clamp prevents. New `reason` values MUST be registered in the schema's enum so cross-language SDKs can dispatch without parsing prose; future per-agent state additions belong on new dedicated codes (each with its own clamped details shape), NOT by relaxing this shape. The cross-tenant onboarding oracle clamp and its full channel-coverage requirements are normative in `error-handling.mdx` Per-Agent Authorization Gate — this schema description does not restate them to avoid drift.

scope.description: Discriminator that this `PERMISSION_DENIED` was triggered by a per-buyer-agent gate (as opposed to a generic credential-shaped failure). Registered subset of `enums/error-scope.json` — sellers MUST set this field exactly to `"agent"` for this shape, and MUST omit `scope` entirely when responding on the unauthenticated/unestablished-identity path required by the cross-tenant oracle clamp. The `AGENT_SUSPENDED` / `AGENT_BLOCKED` codes (per-agent commercial status) do NOT carry an explicit `scope` field — the code itself is the discriminator on those paths, mirroring `BILLING_NOT_PERMITTED_FOR_AGENT`.

reason.description: Registered per-agent gate that fired. `"sandbox_only"` — the agent is provisioned for sandbox traffic only and the request was against a non-sandbox account. `"grant_absent"` (added in 3.3, experimental with demand-side grants) — the agent's identity is established but no grant authorizes it to act for the account's brand, as docs/building/by-layer/L2/accounts-and-agents.mdx §Grants in trust records describes (DR-0025). New `reason` values MUST be added here (the enum is closed by `additionalProperties: false`) so cross-language SDKs can dispatch without parsing prose.
